sections.title: 3. Data Security & Protection
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Our website uses SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission. Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only. While we take every reasonable precaution, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing & Third Parties
sections.content: We do NOT sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. We may share your information only with: trusted service partners directly involved in fulfilling your order (e.g., delivery services, installation contractors); legal authorities when required by law or to protect our rights; analytics providers who help us understand website usage (data is anonymized). All third-party service providers are bound by confidentiality agreements.

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
sections.content: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Essential cookies are required for basic site functionality (session management, preferences). Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our site. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality. We do not use cookies for targeted advertising. Our PWA (Progressive Web App) may store data locally on your device for offline access.

items.label: Access & Correction
items.desc: You have the right to request access to your personal data and to correct any inaccuracies.

items.label: Data Deletion
items.desc: You can request deletion of your personal data, subject to our legal obligations and legitimate business needs.

items.label: Opt-Out
items.desc: You can opt out of promotional communications at any time by contacting us directly.

items.label: Data Portability
items.desc: You can request a copy of your personal data in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

items.label: Withdraw Consent
items.desc: Where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting prior processing.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Order and transaction records are retained for a minimum of 5 years for tax and legal compliance. Communication records are retained for 2 years after the last interaction. Analytics data is retained in anonymized form indefinitely. Upon expiration of retention periods, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately, and we will take steps to delete such information from our systems.

sections.title: 9. International Data Transfers
sections.content: Your information may be stored and processed on servers located in Pakistan. If you access our website from outside Pakistan, please be aware that your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in Pakistan where our servers are located and our central database is operated. By using our services, you consent to this transfer.

sections.title: 10. Third-Party Links

We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit through links on our site.

sections.title: 11. Policy Updates
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, or legal requirements. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Continued use of our services after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: 12. Contact Us

sections.title: 1. Introduction & Acceptance
sections.content: Welcome to Wazir Glass & Aluminium Centre. By accessing or using our website, services, and placing any order for glass, aluminium, or related products, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. sections.title: 2. Products & Services
sections.content: We specialize in the fabrication, supply, and installation of premium aluminium windows, doors, glass partitions, shop fronts, shower enclosures, decorative mirrors, and custom architectural glass solutions. All product images, dimensions, and specifications listed on our website are for illustrative purposes and may vary slightly from the final delivered product due to the custom nature of our work. Colours displayed on-screen may differ from actual shades due to monitor calibration.

sections.title: 3. Pricing & Payments
sections.content: All prices quoted are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) unless otherwise stated. Prices are subject to change without prior notice based on raw material costs, market fluctuations, and project specifications. A minimum advance payment of 50% is required before fabrication begins. Remaining balance is due upon completion before delivery/installation. We accept cash, bank transfer, and other agreed-upon payment methods. Quotations are valid for 15 days from the date of issue unless extended in writing.

sections.title: 4. Order Processing & Timelines
sections.content: Orders are processed after confirmation of advance payment and final measurements. Standard fabrication timelines range from 7 to 21 working days depending on project scope and complexity. Timelines may be affected by material availability, weather conditions, or unforeseen circumstances. We will communicate any delays promptly. Rush orders may be accommodated at an additional charge, subject to production capacity.

sections.title: 5. Delivery & Installation
sections.content: Delivery charges are calculated based on distance and order size, and will be communicated at the time of quotation. Installation services are available at an additional cost and will be performed by our trained professionals. The customer is responsible for ensuring clear site access, power supply, and a safe working environment. Any site preparation (such as wall cutting, plumbing adjustments, or civil work) is the customer's responsibility unless explicitly included in the quotation. Risk of damage transfers to the customer upon delivery and acceptance.

sections.title: 6. Warranty & Guarantee
sections.content: We provide a limited warranty on fabrication quality for a period of one (1) year from the date of installation. This warranty covers defects in workmanship and material failure under normal use. The warranty does NOT cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, natural disasters, unauthorized modifications, improper cleaning agents, or normal wear and tear. Glass breakage due to external impact, thermal stress, or improper handling by the customer after delivery is not covered. Hardware components (locks, handles, hinges) carry their respective manufacturer warranties.

sections.title: 7. Returns, Cancellations & Refunds
sections.content: Due to the custom-made nature of our products, returns and cancellations are subject to the following conditions: Orders may be cancelled within 48 hours of placement, provided fabrication has not commenced. If fabrication has started, a cancellation fee of up to 40% of the total order value will be charged. Custom-cut glass and bespoke aluminium profiles are non-returnable and non-refundable. Refunds, where applicable, will be processed within 15 business days via the original payment method.
